name: ai-chat
description: Standalone Go backend for the AI theme-builder chat feature — no frontend of its own (consumed by tenant-dashboard). This package.json exists only so `npm run dev` works uniformly across the flowPOS monorepo's polyglot projects; there is no Node runtime dependency.

scripts.dev: cd backend && (command -v air >/dev/null 2>&1 && air || go run ./cmd/server)
